question: How many orders are in the dataset?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: How many unique customers (real people, not order-level customer ids) are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers

question: How many orders have each order status?
gold_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY order_status

question: What share of orders were canceled, as a percentage?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM orders

question: What is total revenue (sum of item prices) across all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(price) FROM order_items

question: What is the total freight value paid across all order items?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(freight_value) FROM order_items

question: What is the average order value, where order value is the sum of item prices in the order?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(v) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS v FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question: Which customer state has the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders came from each customer state?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state

question: What is the average review score?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(review_score) FROM reviews

question: How many reviews gave each score from 1 to 5?
gold_sql: SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) FROM reviews GROUP BY review_score

question: What percentage of reviews are 5 stars?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM reviews

question: How many orders were paid with each payment type?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM payments GROUP BY payment_type

question: What is the total payment value by payment type?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, SUM(payment_value) FROM payments GROUP BY payment_type

question: What is the average number of installments for credit card payments?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(payment_installments) FROM payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

question: What is the highest number of installments used on any payment?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(payment_installments) FROM payments

question: How many sellers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers

question: How many sellers are based in each state?
gold_sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state

question: Which 5 sellers have the highest total revenue from item prices? Return seller id and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many products are in each product category (English name)?
gold_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY 1

question: Which product category (English name) has the highest total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(i.price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is total item revenue per product category in English?
gold_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, SUM(i.price) FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY 1

question: What is the average item price per product category in English?
gold_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, AVG(i.price) FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY 1

question: How many orders were placed in each month? Use the purchase timestamp.
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY m

question: Which month had the most orders placed?
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS m FROM orders GROUP BY m ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were placed in 2018?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE year(order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018

question: What is total item revenue by year of purchase?
gold_sql: SELECT year(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS y, SUM(i.price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY y

question: Among delivered orders, what share was delivered after the estimated delivery date, as a percentage?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: What is the average delivery time in days from purchase to customer delivery, for delivered orders?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(date_diff('day', order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date)) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: What is the average delivery time in days by customer state, for delivered orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(date_diff('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

question: Which customer state has the longest average delivery time for delivered orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY AVG(date_diff('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average review score for delivered orders that arrived late versus on time?
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END, AVG(r.review_score) FROM orders o JOIN reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

question: What is the average review score by customer state?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(r.review_score) FROM reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY 1

question: What is the average review score per product category in English?
gold_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, AVG(r.review_score) FROM reviews r JOIN order_items i ON r.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY 1

question: How many customers (unique people) placed more than one order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1)

question: What percentage of unique customers are repeat buyers with more than one order?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN n > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM (SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY customer_unique_id)

question: How many orders contain more than one item?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

question: What is the average number of items per order?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(n) FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question: What is the average freight value as a percentage of item price?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(freight_value) / SUM(price) FROM order_items

question: What is the average freight value per item by seller state?
gold_sql: SELECT s.seller_state, AVG(i.freight_value) FROM order_items i JOIN sellers s ON i.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY 1

question: How many orders were shipped by a seller in the same state as the customer?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN sellers s ON i.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE c.customer_state = s.seller_state

question: What is the average product weight in grams per product category in English?
gold_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, AVG(p.product_weight_g) FROM products p JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY 1

question: How many products have more than 3 photos?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_photos_qty > 3

question: What is the most expensive item price ever sold?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(price) FROM order_items

question: Which city has the most customers (unique people)?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_city FROM customers GROUP BY customer_city ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average payment value for orders paid by boleto?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(payment_value) FROM payments WHERE payment_type = 'boleto'

question: What is the average review score for orders paid with each payment type?
gold_sql: SELECT p.payment_type, AVG(r.review_score) FROM payments p JOIN reviews r ON p.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY 1

question: How many delivered orders from the state SP arrived late?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP' AND o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date

question: What is the median item price?
gold_sql: SELECT MEDIAN(price) FROM order_items

question: What is the correlation between product weight and freight value across order items?
gold_sql: SELECT CORR(p.product_weight_g, i.freight_value) FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
